name: Skills Lab: list, editor tabs, version diff, and agent skill links
description: Read-only walk through the seeded demo skills (server/src/db/seed-skills.ts). Loads /skills and confirms the three seeded skills render; opens pr-quality-rubric and checks the Config tab, the Preview tab (markdown rendered as the agent receives it), and the Versions tab (2 versions, current marker, and a v1→current diff showing a line added in v2). Then opens the Security Reviewer's Skills tab and confirms the two seeded links (2 of 3 enabled). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where the seeded skills are the only skills — guaranteed by the hermetic runner / e2e-web.yml.
